newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos seeks pipeline expansion.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos seeks pipeline expansion.

text.p: Williams Cos Inc said it filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to expand its Southeast Louisiana Gathering System by 660 million cubic feet of gas per day at an estimated cost of $129 million.
The expansion involves the addition of 50.7 miles of 30-inch loop extending from Ship Shoal Block 14 to Ship Shoal Block 214 in the Gulf of Mexico for completion by November 1997.
A second phase of 26.9 miles of 30-inch loop extending from Ship Shoal Block 214 to a new juction platform to being constructed at South Timbalier Block 301 for completion by 1998, the company said.
The company is pursuing this expansion to avoid delays in meeting producers' needs to gather gas from deep-water oil and gas production, Williams said.
